nodes.summary: A real-analytic orientation-preserving diffeomorphism of the circle is given by a lift $F : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ together with an inverse lift $G : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, both real-analytic on all of $\mathbb{R}$, such that for every real $x$ we have $F(x + 1) = F(x) + 1$, $G(x + 1) = G(x) + 1$, $G(F(x)) = x$ and $F(G(x)) = x$, and $F$ is strictly increasing.
nodes.title: Real-analytic circle diffeomorphisms

nodes.summary: There is an irrational real number $\alpha$ that is not Diophantine such that, for every real-analytic circle diffeomorphism whose lift $F$ has rotation number $\alpha$, $F$ is analytically conjugate to the rotation by $\alpha$.
nodes.title: Herman's analytic linearization problem has a positive answer

nodes.summary: The statement that there is an irrational real number $\alpha$ that is not Diophantine such that, for every real-analytic circle diffeomorphism whose lift $F$ has rotation number $\alpha$, $F$ is analytically conjugate to the rotation by $\alpha$.
nodes.title: Herman's analytic linearization problem

nodes.summary: Let $F : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be a function, and for a natural number $n$ write $F^n$ for the $n$-th iterate of $F$. Then $F$ has rotation number $\alpha \in \mathbb{R}$ when, for every real $x$, $(F^n(x) - x)/n$ tends to $\alpha$ as $n$ tends to infinity.
nodes.title: Rotation number of a lift

nodes.summary: A function $F : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is analytically conjugate to the rotation by $\alpha \in \mathbb{R}$ when there is a real-analytic circle diffeomorphism with lift $H$ such that $H(F(x)) = H(x) + \alpha$ for every real $x$.
nodes.title: Analytic conjugacy to a rotation

nodes.summary: A real number $\alpha$ is Diophantine when there are real numbers $\gamma > 0$ and $\tau \ge 0$ such that $|\alpha - p/q| \ge \gamma / q^{2 + \tau}$ for every integer $p$ and every integer $q \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Diophantine numbers
